verdict.rationale: Trilegal's IP page says it advises on "trade secrets, and confidential information" and represents clients in "high-stakes litigation involving... trade secrets." Its Labour and Employment practice documents a concrete employee-mobility matter: the exit of a startup's CTO and co-founder "without compromising on its highly critical intellectual property and proprietary information." Missing for 10: any named trade-secret litigation matter or case outcome, documented confidentiality-program design work, a dedicated trade-secret practice page, and independent corroboration or rankings for this work.
